notes.title: 0.12.0 Major Balance Update
notes.content:
A major balance update 0.12.0 has been released!

Prior to 0.12.0, the game was too hard at the start and too easy once you passed a certain point.

In this update we've adjusted the Bitcoin price curve in an attempt to have a more linear difficulty.

Have a play and tell us what you think!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33638009/0dfcde8f967dba1879c1888c5cb888d161a1b13e.png[/img]

notes.title: 0.11.0 Major Update
notes.content:
A major update 0.11.0 has been released:
[list]
[*] All graphics have been completed! New models and textures
[*] Added smartphone feature which allows you to track the price of Bitcoin without having to go to the Market menu, you can also sell Bitcoin using the smartphone
[*] Revamped story and added a story telling mechanism to the smartphone
[*] Major game balance changes
[*] Added new copy chassis feature
[*] Added new achievements
[*] Added several new music tracks
[*] Added a tutorial
[*] Loan mechanic removed, now all you have to do to win is hold $150,000,000
[*] Global leaderboards have been removed as we have no anti-cheat mechanisms. Friends leaderboards will remain.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33638009/da3ac98d97ae2420df0ad70dbacfebb56f554937.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33638009/007e10ddc71c808d5d4ef7215ad354f3854ab73a.png[/img]

notes.title: Beta - New features, huge re-balance, new story elements and more!
notes.content:
Happy holidays and welcome to the new year!

We've had our heads down working towards the final release of the game and we're not too far away now.

There have been quite a few changes since our last update to the game and we would like to share them with you early!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33638009/cbb85b18dff0c4bc1df47421ca592dfa83bfcf2b.png[/img]

Some of the notable changes include new quality of life features, a new story telling mechanism with new story elements, updated models and textures, new music and of course a huge re-balancing of the game!

If you want to check out these changes you'll need to opt into the beta. To do this:
[list]
[*] In your Steam library right click Crypto Crisis and select "Properties"
[*] Click on the last tab "Betas"
[*] Click the dropdown and select the "beta" option
[*] The game should update
[/list]

notes.title: 0.10.0 Major Update
notes.content:
A major update 0.10.0 has been released:
[list]
[*] Maps have been completely redone. They should have less of an impact on graphical performance while looking much better complete with textures and better lighting
[*] New top 10 global and friends leaderboard added to main menu
[*] Added new and updated models
[*] Ability to pay off loan with all of your remaining money 
[*] Various minor and major bug fixes
[*] Localised game to simplified and traditional Chinese
[/list]
